What we do

One office for the whole tax year

Returns in the spring, planning in the summer, and someone to call the day an IRS envelope shows up. Tap a heading to see what's under it.

Tax preparation

Your return, prepared and filed by the person sitting across the desk from you — not a call centre and not a login screen.

Ways they look for to lower next year's bill, in their own words:

  • Splitting income between family members or entities so more of it lands in a lower bracket
  • Shifting income or expenses from one year into another
  • Deferring tax through pension plans and similar contributions
  • Using investments whose income is exempt from federal or state tax

13 kinds of trouble they take on without sending you to Seattle:

  • IRS audit representation
  • Non-filed tax returns
  • Back taxes owed
  • Payroll tax problems
  • IRS liens
  • IRS levies
  • IRS wage garnishment
  • IRS seizures
  • Offer in compromise
  • IRS payment plan
  • Bankruptcy
  • Innocent spouse relief
  • Getting your IRS file

For the shops and contractors on the plateau:

  • Strategic business planning
  • New business formation
  • Payroll
  • Bookkeeping
  • QuickBooks consulting

    The firm

    Professionalism, responsiveness, quality

    “Our firm provides outstanding service to our clients because of our dedication to the three underlying principles of professionalism, responsiveness and quality.”

    Their own words, and the second half is the part most people don't expect from a tax office: “We offer support to our clients all year to answer any questions they might have.” The lights don't go off on April 16th.

    It's a small building on a downtown block, not a franchise counter in a strip mall — which is why the reviews keep using the word personal. You get the same names every year, and you can reach any of them directly.
